title: exudyn.symbolic: SymbolicProgram, the evaluation and the one-pass derivative of the user functions by the table of operations
author: Claude-JG
description: Stage 1 of #3153 (decided: slightly different results would be acceptable; the full equivalence checked for now). New files src/Linalg/SymbolicTable.h/.cpp: the operation codes and the table (name, number of operands, rule of the forward derivative), SymbolicProgram built from the flat program, the scalar operations of scalar operands computed by the table, the rest by the nodes; the rules of the forward derivative moved there and shared with FlatProgram; esym.SetTableEvaluation(flag) selects the path, FlatProgram the fallback; every symbolic test model equal to the bit on both paths.
releaseNotes: exudyn.symbolic: the user functions are evaluated and differentiated by a table of their operations, SymbolicProgram, which computes the scalar operations without calling their nodes - the same results bit for bit, less than half the time for a force of many scalar operations; esym.SetTableEvaluation(False) selects the evaluation by the nodes
